public_info.summary: Small preserved treats useful for calming, rewarding, or befriending ordinary animals.
A portable sleeping roll that makes resting away from an inn more comfortable.
A small stick of chalk for marking paths, writing messages, or copying symbols.
A compact edged weapon that can also cut rope, prepare food, or serve as a precise hand tool.
Cosmetics, dyes, false hair, and small props used to alter a person's appearance.
A permanent magical companion that instantly shares everything learned by one player character with the rest of the party.
Well-tailored clothing suited to formal gatherings and situations where appearance matters.
A sturdy metal hook designed to catch ledges, beams, branches, or other secure anchors.
Tools and containers for identifying, gathering, and preparing useful herbs.
A balanced throwing spear that can also function as a pole, probe, or improvised lever.
A protected portable light source useful in darkness and poor weather.
A sturdy one-handed sword carried by the Warrior.
A stringed instrument suitable for performance, accompaniment, and attracting attention.
A handheld lens for examining fine writing, tiny mechanisms, tracks, and physical evidence.
A bound collection of blank pages for notes, sketches, copied clues, and messages.
A personal magical safeguard reserved for the future combat system.
A slender, precisely balanced sword carried by the Bard.
A durable length of rope for climbing, securing objects, binding, or improvising simple mechanisms.
A broad defensive shield that can also brace, block, or push objects.
A compact bow carried by the Rogue.
A compact kit of prepared materials used by the Rogue's Smoke Bomb ability.
A Wizard's collection of magical notes, diagrams, formulae, and observations.
A sturdy walking staff useful for support, probing uncertain ground, and channeling magic.
Fine picks, probes, files, and clamps for working with locks and delicate mechanisms.
A portable wooden light source whose current state may change if it burns, becomes wet, or is damaged.
A personal divine weapon reserved for the future combat system.
A refillable leather container for carrying drinking water.
